title: (No AI) No one is surprised that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/STKP210_JENSEN_HUANG_D.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The man who may stand to make the most money from the AI boom seems to think he knows better than anyone else, including [researchers](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/996563/ai-safety-research-metr-redwood-openai-anthropic) who have studied and [worked on AI](https://www.theverge.com/podcast/996412/microsoft-ai-ceo-mustafa-suleyman-regulation-safety-anthropic-claude) for decades. In an interview with _[CBS Sunday Morning](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-rejects-ai-extinction-warnings/)_, he claimed there was a "0% chance" of [AI being the end of the world](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/991927/anthropic-ai-kill-all-humans). He also said of people sounding the alarm about the dangers of AI that, "Scaring people is unnecessary. It is irresponsible."

He also claims that calls from CEOs like Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman to [slow down](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/994337/anthropic-ceo-slow-down-ai-development) the development of AI are "not grounded in science." He even argued that there was no need for new rules, laws, or guidelines, in …

title: (No AI) Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Graphic photo illustration of Donald Trump.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25334825/STK466_ELECTION_2024_CVirginia_E.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The president posted on Truth Social that he wanted to appoint an "AI czar" to lead a new "AI force." He [made](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-says-he-will-create-ai-force-name-ai-czar-2026-09-19/) the [announcement](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqlykr2vrv04o) amid [growing calls](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/996923/ai-safety-slow-openai-anthropic) from across the political spectrum and even within the industry to [pump the brakes](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/994337/anthropic-ceo-slow-down-ai-development) on AI development. He posted that his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the Growth of this incredible Industry. Rather, we will cherish it, help it, and watch over it, as it grows!"

In the rambling post, Trump said that data centers were "wealthy and prestigious" and claimed without evidence that they raised salaries, lowered taxes, and made for safer streets in the communities in which they were …
